title: STILL-PRESENT: W-2 pool-cap clamp excludes cap 1 — a legal pool_max_packets=1 catalog still yields a Pool_Exhaustion crisis that can never resolve
detail: At cap 1 the `> 1` guard skips the clamp: pool_margin stays 2 and `len + 2 < 1` never holds, so the pool crisis triggers but never resolves — even with an empty, recovered pool. Cap 2 resolves; cap 1 (the r3 W-2 finding's other legal cap) remains a permanent crisis.
recommended_fix: Clamp the resolve margin to min(CRISIS_RESOLVE_MARGIN, cap-1) — drop the `> 1` guard so cap 1 gets margin 0 (the N5 pattern) — and pin a cap-1 resolve test.
